query:
SELECT 
  productName,
  expiryDate,
  quantity,
  costPrice,
  (costPrice * quantity) as value,
  createdAt
FROM inventory 
WHERE MONTH(createdAt) = 5 AND YEAR(createdAt) = 2026
  AND (productName LIKE '%Azithromycin%' OR productName LIKE '%Doxycycline%')
ORDER BY expiryDate;
